category: 👀 Secret societies
content:
Ebuc walks in leaving a note for Daysong written in Gnomish

|| .
My time was short, quick, and fun.
The lives of all, absolve to one.
One chance we have, to end a blight.
Do not grieve, if I die tonight

A fez you wear, a proud head piece.
One that most, would just release.
My brothers and sisters, Masons of all.
Tonight I fight, and I'll stand tall

I do not fear, the possible chance.
Of playing with death, and losing the dance.
I battle in hope, of a brighter day.
One that most, attempted to sway.

For this may be, my final say.
Alas, fear not, enjoy the day.
I fight for you, Master Daysong.
I hope you know, I meant no wrong.

A mason devout, I wish to be.
Keep your lanterns lit, and pray for me.
Do not weep, do not cry.
Farewell, my friends, no... Family....goodbye.

. ||
